hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'prisma/migrations/'; then echo 'Do not edit migration files directly. Use pnpm db:migrate:create instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md|scss)$'; then if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/client/'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/client" && pnpm exec prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/server/'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/server" && pnpm exec prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/client/'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/client" && pnpm exec eslint --no-warn-ignored "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -5; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/server/'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/server" && pnpm exec eslint --no-warn-ignored "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; fi
